description: OKX public REST market trades, order books and ticker for USDT-margined perpetual swaps (BTC-USDT-SWAP)
permission_basis: Public market data served without authentication by OKX public REST endpoints (/market/trades, /market/history-trades, /market/books, /market/ticker), used for research only; raw payloads are not redistributed. OKX Terms of Service reviewed 2026-11-18. This registry entry is an explicit research-use assertion, not a legal determination.
timestamp_basis: Exchange event time: trade match time and book snapshot time in UTC milliseconds; a trade is knowable when it prints on the public feed, a snapshot when it is taken.
